events.title: 첼시 signed 레알 마드리드 and France midfielder Claude Makélélé for £16.6 million.
토트넘 홋스퍼 sacked Glenn Hoddle after two-and-a-half years as manager. Director of football David Pleat took temporary charge.
Dutch club Zwolle sacks manager Peter Boeve .

윔블던 relocated to Milton Keynes where they would play at the National Hockey Stadium , but this was a temporary measure; there were plans to build a new 25,000-seat stadium at Denbigh North which was expected to be completed in either 2006 or 2007.

아스널 led the Premier League, but their nearest challengers 첼시 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 were just a point behind. Surprise title contenders 버밍엄 시티 and 사우샘프턴 completed the top five, but there was widespread doubt as to whether they could continue their good form and make a serious challenge to record their first-ever top division title. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 were still bottom and looking for their first win of the season; 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 completed the bottom three. 셰필드 유나이티드 led the way in Division One, a point ahead of former leaders 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. 위건 애슬레틱, 노리치 시티 , 선덜랜드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 occupied the play-off zone.
